facts.fact: The Electoral Commission says it issued soft copies of the photo-bearing National Voters' Register, covering 21,681,491 registered voters at 50,739 polling stations, to presidential candidates, and that the register is the basis for voting in the 2026 elections.

The Electoral Commission says the National Voters Register was displayed in 2025 and urges the public to use its official website ec.or.ug/register to verify voter registration particulars and polling station.
